abstracted_predicate.name: ASSESSES_COMPETING_ACCOUNTS_OF_SAME_OBSERVATION
abstracted_predicate.definition: The reasoning explicitly identifies two or more candidate accounts, such as alternative explanations, interpretations, or source-derived values, that purport to explain or characterize the same observed situation, entity, or evidence. It presents these accounts as mutually competing candidates rather than as a single settled account, and either leaves them as explicitly undetermined rivals to be resolved before action or selects one as preferred or authoritative with an identifiable distinguishing justification.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that enumerates, contrasts, and, where applicable, resolves multiple competing accounts of the same observed situation, entity, or evidence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names or clearly describes at least two distinct candidate accounts that purport to explain or characterize the same observed situation, entity, or evidence.
The candidate accounts are presented as competing or rival possibilities rather than as sequential plan steps, independent facts, or alternative courses of action.

Where the reasoning selects a preferred or authoritative candidate, it supplies an identifiable distinguishing consideration or justification for that selection, such as greater coverage of the evidence, internal consistency, source authority, or incompatibility of a rival with the observation.
Where the reasoning does not select a preferred or authoritative candidate, it explicitly marks the alternatives as undetermined rival candidates whose truth remains to be resolved before action.
exclusion_conditions: Only a single account, explanation, interpretation, or source-derived value is offered.
The enumerated items are steps of a plan, candidate solutions, course-of-action options, or unrelated facts rather than rival accounts of the same observation.
The alternatives concern different entities, different evidence, or different scopes, so they are not competing accounts of the same observed situation.

A discrepancy or conflict between information sources is merely noted and left unresolved without either explaining the alternatives as rival candidate accounts or selecting an authoritative value with justification.
One account is already asserted as established without acknowledging any genuine competition among alternatives.
